If it comes out EQUAL OR LARGER, the result is UNINTERPRETABLE rather than a refutation, because the inflation could account for it. R2 is then reported as inconclusive at this floor, not as refuted. Also record that the AdamW arm's floor of 0 is a property of the duplicated seed, not of the arm: seeds 20261007 and 20261008 did not reproduce bitwise at epoch 1.

established_before_registration.head_is_training_noop: An output head theta -> theta - P_G theta leaves the hinge_mix loss unchanged as a function of the network weights: the loss depends on theta only through structure totals, and d loss/d theta is a combination of structure count vectors, orthogonal to G(x). Proved and checked by three independent lenses (weight gradients agree to 2.4e-7 relative); P0.3 regenerates the check into an artifact. Network form of docs/gauge.md:116-122.
established_before_registration.live_study: Arms 1 (AdamW w=1.0) and 2 (AdamW w=0.125) are the live fresh runs of runs/2026-10-07_mxfold2_seed_study, with duplicates for an epoch-10 floor.
established_before_registration.resume_inexact: MXfold2 --resume re-seeds and restores no RNG state; cuDNN's RNN dropout state cannot be restored. Arm 1 of the original proposal is not resumed.
established_before_registration.turner_frozen: In MixC under hinge_mix the Turner tables receive no gradient.
established_before_registration.weight_space_gauge_v: v = +1 on zuker.net.fc_paired.fc.4.bias[0] (S channel), -2 on zuker.fc_length.score_helix_length.net.0.weight[0, 2..30]. Moving the weights along v moves every S entry by delta and helix_length[m] by -2 delta (m-1), i.e. along the output gauge h; the loss is flat along v on every step whose pred and ref contain no helix longer than 30 pairs (3 TR0 references do). Under AdamW, v.w moved by -4.8 to +5.4 across the 8 seeds in epoch 1 (seed SD ~1 at init, ~3.2 after epoch 1).

phase0.P0_1_masks: torch masks equal Geometry (uppercased) on every TR0 and TS0 sequence; torch null_norm2 equals Geometry.proj_norm2 on the TS0 theta of the shipped TrainSetAB weights to <= 1e-10 relative
phase0.P0_2_v_symmetry: 30 seeded TR0 sequences, shipped weights, eval mode, delta = 0.37: every S entry moves by delta and helix_length[m] by -2 delta (m-1) within 1e-5 absolute, M and U are unchanged within 1e-6, the hinge_mix loss changes by <= 1e-6 relative and |v.grad L| / (|v| |grad L|) <= 1e-6, the last two on sequences whose pred and ref have no helix > 30 pairs
phase0.P0_3_head_noop: 30 seeded TR0 sequences <= 200 nt, shipped weights: hinge_mix weight gradient with the head (canonicalise inserted after make_param) vs without, in eval mode and in train mode with identical dropout: relative L2 difference <= 1e-5 and identical argmax structures; deterministic positive control: projecting out the unit direction of the step's own theta-gradient, after removing its G component (a non-null direction by construction), must change the weight gradient by >= 1e-3 relative on every sequence and mode
phase0.P0_4_defining_check: all 1,305 TS0 sequences, shipped TrainSetAB weights: identical predicted structures with and without the head, except near-tie flips whose score gap under the original parameters is <= tie_bound * max(1, |E|) + abs_floor; |dE| <= dE_rel_tol * max(1, |E|) + abs_floor for the predicted and (where realisable) the reference structure (abs_floor covers float32 summation, whose error scales with the partial sums rather than |E|); residual null norm of the canonical theta <= 1e-12 * ||theta||^2

P0_4_negative_controls.NC1: theta - ||P_G theta|| r (r a random direction on theta's coordinates, its G component removed, unit norm in theta space) must change the predicted-structure score by > 1e-3 relative on >= 95% of sequences and change at least one predicted structure
P0_4_negative_controls.NC2: the head without h (g_p only) must leave a residual null norm >= 100 x the full head's on >= 90% of the sequences where h is in G
P0_4_negative_controls.NC3: a random G perturbation (norm = ||theta||) applied before the head must not survive it: canonical tables equal within 1e-4 absolute, and the predicted structure equal to the head's own (s_c) up to near-ties as in P0.4, on every sequence

phase0.P0_5_runner: CPU, 20 seeded TR0 sequences <= 80 nt: (a) gauge runner with lambda = 0 is bitwise equal to the plain timed runner after 1 epoch (AdamW); (b) the same for --optimizer SGD; (c) 1 epoch + resume to epoch 2 with the RNG sidecar is bitwise equal to 2 uninterrupted epochs; (d) the stdout 'Train Epoch' loss lines parse; (e) positive control: lambda = 1 changes the weights; (f) the float64 CPU crosscheck of R agrees to <= 1e-9
phase0.stop_rule: any Phase 0 failure stops everything; nothing trains

pilot.arms: lambda = 0 and lambda_f = f * L0 / R0 for f in grid, where L0 and R0 are the held-out mean hinge_mix loss and mean R at step 0 in eval mode; every arm re-seeded identically (same order, same dropout)
pilot.data: 500 seeded TR0 sequences <= 200 nt as the training stream; 200 disjoint seeded TR0 sequences <= 200 nt held out; TS0 never used
pilot.rule: choose the smallest f with rho = R_ho(lambda, 500) / R_ho(0, 500) <= 0.5 and delta = L_ho(lambda, 500) / L_ho(0, 500) - 1 <= 0.02; if none qualifies, the regulariser arm is NOT launched and the SGD arm proceeds alone
pilot.start: seeds/seed20261006_w1.0/checkpoints/epoch-1 of the live study (model and AdamW state), read only

C1.prior_impl: Canonicalised predictions are identical on every evaluated model (structures; scores within the P0.4 tolerance)

predictions.F: TS0 PPV/SEN/F per model and per arm reported with NO prediction

G1.operational: more than 50% of ||theta_A - theta_B||^2, pooled over TS0, lies in G; compared at matched training loss (e_A = 10, e_B = earliest SGD epoch with loss <= L_A(10); if none, e_B = 10 and e_A = the AdamW epoch whose loss is closest to L_B(10); labelled descriptive if the matched losses differ by > 10%); reported against three baselines: dim G / dim theta, 20 random directions per sequence, AdamW-AdamW and SGD-SGD seed pairs
G1.prior_impl: likely refuted: a CPU probe put 16-28% of a theta change in G
G1.rule_spec: Without the head, A (AdamW seed 20261006, live) vs B (SGD seed 20261006) differ mostly in the null component.

G2.rule_spec: With the head, the identifiable component of C vs D is smaller than that of A vs B by more than the floor.
G2.status: REFUTED BY CONSTRUCTION before any training: the head is a training no-op (established_before_registration.head_is_training_noop; P0.3)

G3.operational: floor = bitwise difference of duplicate runs: epoch 1 already bitwise 0 (seed study determinism_control); epoch 10 from the live _dup runs and reg_dup
G3.rule_spec: The floor is small relative to both.

H1.rule_spec: Arms 3 and 4 have zero null-space seed variance and smaller identifiable seed variance than arms 1 and 2.
H1.status: split: 'zero null variance' of canonicalised tables is a CHECK; 'smaller identifiable variance' from the head is REFUTED BY CONSTRUCTION; the non-tautological successor is R2

H2.rule_spec: Arms 3 and 4 are indistinguishable because the head already pins the constant shift the regulariser was pinning.
H2.status: WITHDRAWN: c_x is not in G (13-79% of it lies outside), so the head does not touch it, and H2 contradicts the filed W2

R1.prior_impl: The regulariser arm has smaller null-space seed variance V_G than live AdamW w=1.0 (a check that the penalty works), paired seed bootstrap interval of the median log ratio below 0

R2.prior_impl: The regulariser arm has smaller IDENTIFIABLE seed variance than live AdamW w=1.0; paired seed bootstrap interval of the median per-sequence log ratio below 0. Uncertain. If refuted, the result is the diagnosis alone: gauge drift is real and optimiser-dependent, harmless to predictions, and it invalidates reading learned tables as energies.

S1.prior_impl: SGD conserves v.w exactly except on long-helix steps: the v.w trace of every SGD run equals its linear reconstruction from the logged per-step v.g under Nesterov momentum (relative error <= 1e-6 of the trace's range), and v.w changes only on steps whose pred or ref has a helix > 30 pairs

S2.prior_impl: Under AdamW the seed SD of v.w grows from epoch 0 to epoch 10 (live AdamW w=1.0 and w=0.125 checkpoints)

W1.amended_2026_10_08: before any analysis: the 95% interval for the median over sequences of log(V_G(0.125) / V_G(1.0)) comes from a paired SEED-LEVEL bootstrap (all 1,305 per-sequence variances share the same 8 models, so a sequence bootstrap omits the dominant error); 'same' = interval inside [log 0.8, log 1.25]; the original sequence bootstrap is reported as secondary
W1.rule_spec: Null-space seed variance is the same in arms 1 and 2.

W2.operational: kappa_k(x) = <theta_k, c_x'> / ||c_x'||^2 with c_x = +1 on every S and M entry and +(b-a+1) on U(a,b) (0 on U(a,a-1)), c_x' = c_x - P_G c_x; statistic = median over x of Var_0.125 / Var_1.0 > 1, paired seed bootstrap
W2.rule_spec: The constant-shift direction varies more in arm 2 than arm 1.

runs.amendments: any change after registration is appended by --phase amend with a date and reason and committed before the step it affects

arms.reg: all 8 recorded seeds; AdamW (code default); w = 1.0; lambda = lambda* from the pilot artifact
arms.reg_dup: a duplicate of reg seed 20261006 on the other GPU (epoch-10 floor; fills wave 2's idle slot)
arms.sgd: seeds 20261006, 20261007, 20261008; --optimizer SGD (MXfold2: Nesterov, momentum 0.9, wd 0) at the default lr 1e-3; w = 1.0; lambda = 0 (R logged)

runs.limits: <= 3 of our processes per GPU; at most one start per GPU per 120 s; a run starts only if its GPU has >= 7500 MiB free, the disk >= 5 GB free and the run code (runner, hooks, gauge, timed wrapper) is byte-identical to launch
runs.pairing: every run is seed-paired with the live AdamW w=1.0 run of the same seed (same initialisation, data order and dropout draws)
runs.resume_policy: a run that dies resumes from its newest loadable checkpoint with the RNG sidecar (data order exact; on the GPU every dropout mask diverges after the first post-resume step), flagged trajectory_exact = false; at most 2 recoveries; NaN = diverged, not retried; every analysis also reported with flagged runs excluded; if sgd seed 20261006 is flagged, a fresh rerun is queued last and replaces it for A-vs-B
runs.settings: TR0 uncapped, 10 epochs, checkpoints every epoch, PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
runs.smoke: first: two concurrent 1-epoch runs on 200 seeded TR0 sequences, one per GPU, in the reg configuration (or SGD with lambda = 0 if no lambda* qualified): checkpoints bitwise identical and the CPU float64 crosscheck of R <= 1e-9; peak memory and epoch time recorded; any failure stops
runs.wait: start only after no live seed-study process remains
